input.command: graphify query "who uses Dialog from controlled-dialog" 2>&1 | head -40; sed -n 1,60p packages/features/components/controlled-dialog/index.tsx

rg -l "controlled-dialog" --glob '!graphify-out' --glob '!node_modules' . | sort; echo ---; rg -n "controlled-dialog" --glob '!graphify-out' --glob '!node_modules' . | rg -v "import .*Dialog.* from" | head -30

rg -U -n --glob '!graphify-out' --glob '!node_modules' "import[^;]*?from\s+[\"'][^\"']*controlled-dialog[^\"']*[\"']" . | rg -v "^\S+-" | rg "controlled-dialog" | head -80; echo; rg -n "controlled-dialog" -g '!graphify-out' -g '!node_modules' . | rg -v "import "

rg -l "controlled-dialog" -g '!graphify-out' -g '!node_modules' . | sort > /tmp/all.txt; rg -U -l --glob '!graphify-out' "import \{ Dialog \} from \"@calcom/features/components/controlled-dialog\"" . | sort > /tmp/a.txt; comm -23 /tmp/all.txt /tmp/a.txt | while read f; do echo "== $f"; rg -n -B3 "controlled-dialog" $f; done
